ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels occupying approximately 90% of the visible surface, contrasted by low-intensity black pixels localized strictly at the peripheral margins and specific focal spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a sharply defined vertex and symmetric inward-sloping lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration map with irregular pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys along the entire span of the trailing edge; specifically, approximately 10-12 prominent peaks are visible per lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve transitioning from the lateral tips toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dark, high-contrast pixel clusters are localized at the distal tips, consistent with localized scarring or heavy pigmentation at the fluke terminals.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct circular dark spot on the right lobe; irregular darkening and notched topography at the extreme lateral tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Small dark vertical projection visible at the fluke-to-water interface at the central insertion point.
